counterfactual_missing_items: positive pan-cytokeratin or other epithelial markers
dysplastic or carcinomatous surface epithelial component
decisive_items: spindle cells were positive for vimentin, α-smooth muscle actin, p63, p53, and CD68
He had undergone chemoradiotherapy 15 years earlier for squamous cell carcinoma of the left buccal mucosa
response.rationale: R2 is favored because p63 positivity plus the prior squamous cell carcinoma history and atypical spindle/pleomorphic cells indicate sarcomatoid carcinoma; R5 relies on CD68/vimentin and negative cytokeratin but does not account for p63 or the SCC history, and R3/R1 lack the malignant spindle-cell/IHC profile or osteoid, respectively.

rejected.why: Inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor is inconsistent with bizarre nuclei, atypical mitoses, high Ki-67, p53/p63 positivity, and destructive bone invasion.
Osteosarcoma is unsupported because no osteoid or malignant bone matrix is described; only bone destruction is present.
